article_favourite_animals.summary: Most children have an animal they love most. After reading this you can name your favourite animal, say where it lives and what it eats, and describe an animal so well that somebody else can picture it.
article_favourite_animals.title: Talking About Your Favorite Animals

article_lost_passport.summary: Losing a passport is a bureaucratic problem, not a disaster, but only if you act in the right order. After reading this you can report the loss correctly, get the right documents from the right office, and travel home while you wait.
article_lost_passport.title: What to Do When You Lose Your Passport
